# The cases this suite carries

One behaviour per case, named like the L3 suite (`l3-documents`). A run prints one line
per case; a **blocked** case names the work package that owns the missing surface, so the
distance between the brief and the product is visible in every run instead of being deleted.
The pass or fail state is not listed here: the run report carries it.

62 cases, of which 16 are blocked by surfaces the host does not serve yet.

## Authentication and sessions

| Case | Pins | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sign_in_returns_a_session_and_the_user` | `POST /auth/login` → token, expiry, identity | case |
| `sign_out_ends_the_session` | `POST /auth/logout` → the token stops working (`auth.session_expired`) | case |
| `session_reports_the_signed_in_user` | `GET /auth/session` → the same identity and site | case |
| `wrong_password_is_refused_without_saying_which_part` | a wrong password and an unknown user answer the same 401 `auth.invalid_credentials` | case |
| `an_unauthenticated_request_never_reaches_the_engine` | 401 `auth.required`, `Running::engine_ops()` does not move | case |
| `a_password_change_keeps_the_session` | the token that changed the password still answers afterwards | case |
| `the_first_sign_in_secret_needs_a_password_change` | `spot add-user`'s printed secret signs in (and is refused as a bearer key); until the password is chosen only read-session and sign-out answer besides the change, everything else is 403 `cli.password_change_required`; the change replaces the session and spends the secret | case |
| `repeated_wrong_passwords_lock_the_account` | the throttle locks after `lockout_after` failures | blocked: WP-PLT-02.T2: once `backoff_after` failures are in the window the throttle answers `Delay` on every attempt (it never checks whether the delay elapsed), so no further failure is recorded and the `lockout_after`-th failure is unreachable |
| `a_locked_account_reports_its_retry_after` | the 429 carries `details.retry_after` | blocked: WP-PLT-02.T2: the account lockout is unreachable for the same reason, so no refusal can carry the lockout's `retry_after` |
| `a_throttled_sign_in_reports_retry_after` | two failures from one source → 429 `api.rate_limited` with a positive `details.retry_after` | case |
| `a_throttled_sign_in_sets_the_retry_after_header` | the same 429 carries the registry's promised `Retry-After` header | blocked: WP-PLT-02.T2: the throttle's 429 carries `details.retry_after` (the case above pins it) but no layer sets the `Retry-After` header the registry promises; the delay path is WP-PLT-02.T2 and the HTTP error-header mapping, if it is where this belongs, is WP-PLT-05.T2 |

## Lifecycle

| `correct_a_draft_amends_the_posted_entry` | `POST .../correct` → a new draft linked by `amended_from`, the original cancelled | case |

## Blocked by a surface the host does not serve yet

| Case | Pins | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `files: upload_then_download_with_a_range` | upload, download and a ranged download over `/files` | blocked: WP-PLT-10: the host mounts no `/files` routes; the contract's upload, download and range operations are not served |
| `files: an_attached_file_is_not_an_orphan` | an `attach` field names an uploaded file and is not an orphan | blocked: WP-PLT-10: no file service is mounted, so an `attach` field cannot name an uploaded file or prove an orphan |
| `realtime: a_permitted_client_is_notified_and_another_is_not` | `GET /api/v1/realtime` notifies a permitted client and not another | blocked: WP-PLT-08.T2: `GET /api/v1/realtime` is not mounted (the router's own docs name WP-PLT-08.T2) |
| `meta: a_runtime_created_doctype_is_usable_at_once` | a DocType created at run time is usable at once | blocked: WP-PLT-16.T2: `spot serve` builds metadata from the app directories only and never reads the customisation records |
| `naming: a_series_is_gapless_under_50_concurrent_creates` | a naming series is gapless under 50 concurrent creates | blocked: WP-DOC-05: the engine renders no name yet; the sample clients supply `code` themselves |
| `export: a_filtered_export_matches_the_query` | an export under a filter holds the rows the same query lists | blocked: WP-PRD-01.T4: no `/api/v1/export*` route is mounted by the host |

## Sessions

| Case | Pins | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sessions: a_first_sign_in_session_and_a_bearer_secret_cannot_manage_sessions` | `GET /auth/sessions` and `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}` from a session that has not chosen its password are 403, never an empty list; the one-time secret as a bearer and an unsigned request are 401; reading the session with a refused bearer is not a 500 (the API-key refusal itself, `403 permission.denied`, is pinned in `spot-cli`'s `tests/session.rs`) | case |
| `sessions: a_user_lists_and_ends_only_their_own_sessions_and_a_foreign_id_is_not_found` | `GET /auth/sessions` lists the caller's own live sessions, the current one first, with no token in the answer; `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}` is 204 for an own session (that token is 401 on the next request, the current one included) and the same 404 `auth.session_not_found` for another user's id as for an unknown one | case |
